reasons: With the 8 MC cap, semesters 6-8 can hold at most 6 four-MC courses. The six required courses plus CS3210, needed as CS4223's prerequisite, total 7.
CS4223 and CS3237 are Sem 1 only, so both must be in semester 7; CS4222 is Sem 2 only and ES2660 is fixed in semester 8, leaving no room for the extra prerequisite.
CS2101 must precede CS4223 and CS2102 cannot be with ES2660, so the remaining required courses cannot be compressed into the available slots.
